title: Shebitku
summary: King listed in CFAH-10 Table 9 (Egypt Dynasty 25 (Cushite)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 25 (Cushite). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-10 (Table 9, "CFAH Solution for Dynasty 25").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Tier 2, CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 713 BC (took the throne of Egypt; conquest of the Delta)). No tier 1–4 birth year. Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was none none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-10: The Libyan-Cushite Intermediate Period," OSF preprint v1.4 (26 Dec 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/FG4DV, file CFAH-10 The Libyan-Cushite Intermediate Period_v1.4.pdf, Table 9 "CFAH Solution for Dynasty 25", p. 28

reign.date: 713 BC (took the throne of Egypt; conquest of the Delta)
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 2, row 713 comment, p. 40; section “Confirmation from Taharqa and the Tangi-Var Inscription”, p. 25
reign.note: Tangi-Var inscription; 50 years before the Cushite expulsion of 663 BC.
